record.field: ${object.company_id.name or ''} - Overdue invoice reminder n°${object.counter or ''}

Dear customer,

According to our books, the following invoices are overdue:

% for inv in (object.get_invoices() or []).sorted(key='invoice_date'): % endfor % for (currency, total_residual) in (object.total_residual() or []): % endfor
Invoice Number Invoice Date Payment Terms Due Date Order Ref. Type Total Untaxed Total Residual Past Reminders
${inv.name or ''} ${inv.invoice_date and format_date(inv.invoice_date) or ''} ${inv.invoice_payment_term_id.name or ''} ${inv.invoice_date_due and format_date(inv.invoice_date_due) or ''} ${inv.ref or ''} ${inv.move_type or ''} ${inv.currency_id and format_amount(inv.amount_untaxed * (inv.move_type == 'out_refund' and -1 or 1), inv.currency_id) or ''} ${inv.currency_id and format_amount(inv.amount_total * (inv.move_type == 'out_refund' and -1 or 1), inv.currency_id) or ''} ${inv.currency_id and format_amount(inv.amount_residual * (inv.move_type == 'out_refund' and -1 or 1), inv.currency_id) or ''} ${inv.overdue_reminder_counter or 0}
Total Residual in ${currency.name or ''}: ${format_amount(total_residual, currency) if currency else ''}

If you made a payment for these invoices a few days ago, please ignore this email.

% if object.company_id.overdue_reminder_attach_invoice:

You will find enclosed the overdue invoices.

% endif % if (object.counter or 0) > 2:

Despite several reminders, we are disappointed to see that these overdue invoices are still unpaid. In order to avoid legal proceedings, we urge you to pay these overdue invoices in the next days.

% endif

Regards,

% if user and user.signature:

${user.signature | safe}

% endif
